semantics.clock: Update at rising edge of clk; synchronous load and enables imply edge-triggered register, with rising edge chosen as conventional unspecified polarity.
semantics.priority: Original (1): load loads data instead of rotating, regardless of ena.

transitions.load=0,ena=01: old bit 0 becomes bit 99; old bit i becomes bit i-1 for i=1..99
transitions.load=0,ena=10: old bit 99 becomes bit 0; old bit i becomes bit i+1 for i=0..98

semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified; none added.
semantics.initialization: Original gives no initial contents; uninitialized register remains unknown until loaded; no initialization added.
semantics.latency: q updates on the same active edge, with no added cycles

numeric.interpretation: Bit vector; signedness does not affect permutation.
numeric.wrap: Both endpoints wrap; no bit discarded.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit permutation based on original direction rules, not DUT concatenations.
verification.sampling: Drive with clock low; verify no changes before rising edge, then sample after NBA settling; verify falling edge holds.
cases: Load priority for all four ena codes
One-hot traversal for 100 cycles in each direction
verification.failure: Case-inequality mismatch triggers $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original specifies synchronous behavior but no explicit edge polarity.
Original specifies no reset or initial value.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No defined power-up value; do not initialize DUT. Development checks uninitialized four-state simulation and loads before defined-data checks.
